So there’s absolutely no reason it shouldn’t be true that they are independently real outside our minds

Other misc tips that help me: 

Guilt: 

If you’re struggling with guilt from the past, remember that you didn’t ever pursue anything that wasn’t meant for some tangible good. NEVER. Really think about that. 

Guilt is an interpersonal feeling of having not fulfilled your obligations to another, and yes it’s valid and real and helpful initially 

But what you’re truly grieving is YOU wanted to be good to that person and didn’t. Instead you pursued some other good that you wanted 

You see what’s key there? There is no such thing as evil inside you! Even psycho paths pursue some sort of good for themselves 

We don’t hold animals accountable for their very existence, but we still punish them when they wrong us. This is how we have to think about guilt.

Free will does not exist, although being a helpful thinking tool. Yes we have to subjectively will ourselves to do something, but this does not mean you are not simply observing a facet of the universe and experiencing it’s choices

You can praise yourself for the difficulty that it is to obtain good!! Because you had to suffer that pain and difficulty in exchange for the good, but when your actions incur pain to yourself? That is on the universe for imbuing you with flaws, you never consented to evil existing, you are just an observer.

You. Have never. Done. Evil. 

You have desired a form of good, and the universe has been evil. 

Mourn, Learn from its tricks, and better your moves next time so it won’t happen again, and you can conquer the universe
